_about: My own bucket for each of the 30 sampled cards, read one at a time from
`grade.py --sample 30`, which shows the card, its gold pair and the source
text around the cited span - and does not show which arm the card came from.
Written BEFORE `grade.py --grade` was run. There is no version of this file
that was produced after seeing the model's buckets, and the agreement rate in
AICHECK.md is only worth anything because of that ordering.
Three cards I found hardest to place, recorded so the disagreements can be
card-041 (vesicles) - the stem's first clause is the book's definition of
both vesicles and vacuoles, and vacuoles is one of the four options; the
second clause does separate them, so this is a close call.
card-083 (random orientations) - the stem's second half paraphrases the
answer, which is why it is not in the useful bucket.
card-084 (pseudounipolar) - the stem states the defining structure, but
naming it still requires knowing the convention, so this one stayed useful
where card-058 (cell death -> apoptosis, a synonym) did not.
graded_by: the agent that ran T-18, by hand, one card at a time

reasons.card-011: the stem's 'as opposed to the multi-gene unit transcribed as a single mRNA' eliminates 'operon', and 'outside the promoter' eliminates 'promoter'; two of four options are destroyed by the wording
reasons.card-012: the stem contains 'bilayer of phospholipids', which is one of the four options; and only one option is a model, so the others are not the same kind of thing
reasons.card-022: 'due to their hydrophobic side chains' is a synonym for the answer 'nonpolar amino acids'
reasons.card-031: three of four options are positive and the stem says the mutation reduces survival; also 'deleterious qualities' is a prose fragment, not a category a student would name
reasons.card-032: 'enzyme-linked receptor' and 'tyrosine kinase receptor' are both options and the second is an instance of the first, so the general option is also defensible
reasons.card-041: the book's sentence defines vesicles and vacuoles together and both are options
reasons.card-044: the distractors are definitions of cytosol, extracellular matrix and ER - not roles of a junction, and implausible on sight
reasons.card-045: 'the cis face of the Golgi' and 'the receiving side of the Golgi' are two options for the same thing; the source says so in one sentence
reasons.card-047: 'which phrase best describes' with three options about milk, structure and storage; guessable without knowing anything
reasons.card-055: the stem names RNA polymerase II, which is one of the four options
reasons.card-058: 'genetically regulated process of cell death' is the definition of the answer; recall of a synonym
reasons.card-067: the stem says 'produce parathyroid hormone' and the answer is 'parathyroid glands'
reasons.card-075: 'complementary base-pairing rule' and 'the base complementary rule' are two options naming one rule; the card has two correct answers
reasons.card-083: 'allowing any combination of paternal and maternal chromosomes to segregate' paraphrases 'random orientations'
reasons.card-085: 'an orderly, regulated process of cell death' is the definition of apoptosis
reasons.card-087: 'inner cell mass' and 'trophoblast' are embryonic structures, and the stem says 'testicular cell type'; two options are gone on sight
